description:
The Sasi scheme is an initiative by the Government of India aimed at providing financial assistance to women. 

The primary objective of the Sasi scheme is to empower women through financial support for their education and skill development. 

The scheme offers financial assistance for various educational pursuits and vocational training programs. 

Eligible beneficiaries include women from economically weaker sections of society. 

The application process typically involves submitting an application form along with necessary documents to the designated authority. 

The timeline for disbursal of funds and assistance may vary based on the specific program and the implementing agency. 

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Women and Child Development along with state governments. 

Further details regarding specific eligibility criteria and the application process can be accessed through official government portals.
